newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 105-day T-bills yield 7.335 percent at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 105-day T-bills yield 7.335 percent at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 105-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 7.335 percent versus 7.247 percent for the 77-day treasury bills at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The average yield for NZ$75 million of 196-day bills was 7.343 percent versus 7.234 percent for the $75 million of 168-day bills at the last tender.
The average yield for $50 million of 413-day bills was 7.508 percent versus 7.300 percent for the $50 million of 329-day bills tendered last week.
